fix.notes: The eliminated_this_check query uses `hits_needed > 0` as an implicit safety guard (Legal cards have hits_needed=0 and can't appear with status='Not Legal', so the condition is redundant but harmless). No schema changes. The `_rotation` table may be empty between rotations; the `runs > 0` guard prevents a spurious second query in that case.
fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong The `/rotation/` page summary line only showed runs completed and total card count. Users had no way to see how many cards appeared in the most recent check (`in_this_check`) or how many cards were eliminated (became 'Not Legal') specifically due to that check (`eliminated_this_check`). ## What changed - **`decksite/data/rotation.py`** — `load_rotation_summary()` now returns a 4-tuple `(runs, num_cards, in_this_check, eliminated_this_check)`. `in_this_check` is `SUM(hit_in_last_run)` from `_rotation`. `eliminated_this_check` counts cards where `status = 'Not Legal'`, `hit_in_last_run = 0`, and `hits_needed <= TOTAL_RUNS - runs_completed + 1` (i.e., the card was still viable before this run but wasn't seen and is now eliminated). - **`decksite/controllers/resources.py`** — unpacks the new 4-tuple and passes the two new counts to the `Rotation` view. - **`decksite/views/rotation.py`** — `Rotation.__init__` accepts `in_this_check` and `eliminated_this_check` (defaulting to 0 for backward compatibility) and exposes them as instance attributes. - **`decksite/templates/rotation.mustache`** — adds a `

This check: {{in_this_check}} cards in, {{eliminated_this_check}} cards eliminated.

` line inside the existing `{{#runs}}` guard. ## How it was validated - `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks passed) - `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 845 passed, 1 skipped, 89 deselected in 18.69s - The `decksite/data/rotation_test.py` existing test (`test_update_rotation_runs_stores_canonical_names`) continued to pass; no new DB-dependent tests were added since the function requires a live `_rotation` table. Fixes #11946
